title.description: Human-readable car name, e.g. Ferrari 296 GT3

system.description: Carrera product system — mirrors the name segment. The d132 and evolution versions of 'the same car' are DIFFERENT CarModels (different chassis/electronics)

scale.description: Physical scale. Do not infer from system

digital.description: Ships with a digital decoder (per the model as shipped; conversions are garage state in personal repos, not catalog facts)

lights.description: Ships with working lights. Do not infer from digital

tireFrontInnerDiaMm.description: Adjudicated front tire inner diameter (rim). Null = ungrounded, not unknown-to-the-world

oemTireSparePart.description: Carrera spare-tire part number for this car, when published

fitmentBasis.description: Rationale for the adjudicated tire/fitment values; per-source evidence lives in SpecClaim assertions about this thing

notes.description: Quirks: magnet arrangement, known chassis siblings (pending a platform grain), set-exclusivity
